name: Quiet Companion
summary: A worshipper sits on their heels on a prayer rug, facing the Kaaba, with a calm cat resting beside them.
why: The person, rug, and distant Kaaba share one direction, while the cat sits naturally beside the rug. A rear view keeps the scene private and peaceful. The warm ivory, jade, and gold carry the calm character of Quiet Joy into a small moment of companionship.
risk: This is an illustrative mark with several subjects. At 24 pixels the Kaaba band and the cat's ears and tail become less distinct; the scene reads best at 48 pixels and above.

palette.name: QUIET COMPANION / IVORY + JADE + WARM GOLD
